lens: Jackson/Weinberg: closeout membership, classification authority, migration and provenance integrity

findings.summary: Artifact classification maps bypass validation of conflicting declarations in the commit body.
evidence: skills/public/issue/scripts/issue_verify_closeout.py:161-170 returns supplied classifications before parsing body declarations.

Using the composed fixture with its artifact unchanged, appending either 'Classification #42: feature' or 'Classification: feature' only to the message produced the expected standalone refusal, but commit-msg and pre-push both returned ok:true.

A separate probe supplied feature classifications for both targets while the message declared conflicting bug/feature authority and omitted bug proof. Both hooks passed, including pause-to-close, with the critique skipped.
tests/quality_gates/test_issue_bundled_closeout.py:403-408 mutates artifact and message together, leaving this independent-input failure uncovered.
findings.action: Have the issue owner validate and reconcile declarations from both artifact and carrier before selecting floors. Add message-only ambiguity and cross-source disagreement regressions through both hooks.

findings.summary: Hooks narrow invocation scope per artifact, rejecting a valid bundled citation when targets occupy separate artifacts.
evidence: scripts/gates/check_issue_closeout_commit_msg.py:380-386 and scripts/prepush_close_keyword_guard.py:366-394 invoke verification separately for each artifact's numbers.

Keeping the composed two-target packet, result and message unchanged, replacing the single artifact with separate bug #42 and feature #43 artifacts preserved verifier, CLI and draft success but made both hooks fail.
The #42 invocation rejects the complete '#42 #43' citation at issue_resolution_critique.py:64 because #43 falls outside the artificially narrowed invocation.
findings.action: Preserve the complete close invocation through hook dispatch. Resolve artifact classifications together and validate each full citation once before applying classification-group floors. Add separate-artifact and artifact-plus-bare-target cases.

findings.summary: Citation parsing discards repository qualifiers before exact membership validation.
evidence: skills/public/issue/scripts/issue_resolution_critique.py:54 extracts numeric '#N' substrings; the changed equality checks at lines 60-67 inspect only those numbers.

Changing only the composed citation to 'Critique foreign/repo#42 foreign/repo#43: res-42.md' left the local packet and observations unchanged. Verifier, CLI, draft, commit-msg and pre-push all returned ok:true.
The inherited permissive extraction therefore remains a hole in the new exact citation-membership contract.
findings.action: Validate the complete citation-target grammar before projection. Either require bare '#N' tokens or preserve qualified identities and reject foreign repositories; add a final-consumer foreign-citation regression.

counterweight_triage.concern: Classification ambiguity, artifact partitioning and foreign citation projection
counterweight_triage.disposition: All three findings reproduced through consumer code and require bounded repairs before accepting the claimed contract.
When touching dispatch, retain the verifier's citation/observer failure reason in pre-push reports. The reproduced citation refusal currently reports empty missing_fields and missing_close_keywords.

counterweight_triage.concern: Weakening joins or adding a semantic classification oracle
counterweight_triage.disposition: Keep existing controls. Composed success, both removed floors, membership mutations, nonpassing observations, legacy-null migration, strict projection, and source/packet/result/parent/delivery refusals behaved as expected in the bounded replay. Mechanical equality cannot establish truthful evidence prose.

counterweight_triage.concern: Publication, installed behavior and Goal #805 net-value evidence
counterweight_triage.disposition: These remain separate obligations under the supplied closeout observations; this review does not discharge them.

next_move: Repair 810-I1 through 810-I3 and extend the existing composed fixture with independently varied message/artifact declarations, artifact partitions and foreign citation labels. Preserve the passing migration and provenance controls.
non_claims: No live issue-close approval, provider mutation, publication, release or installed-behavior verification.
All 22 semantic carriers matched the supplied bound bytes. Findings concern those bytes and their changes against 23a9eaa6.

Executable probes used an in-memory filesystem overlay and the existing composed fixture helpers; the source seed was replaced with a freshly captured real repository source identity. Workspace files were not edited.
CLI execution was in-process; hook artifact and stored-message inputs were injected. No real Git index, push range or complete standing pytest run was exercised.
Synthetic fixture observations establish consumer behavior, not actual resolution of issues #42, #43 or #810.
